transcript.text:
*bursts through the door, face flushed with anger and clutching a sheaf of disorganized papers*

Salieri! I've been away for two weeks on the Emperor's business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don't know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

*slams the papers down on the nearest table*

What in God's name has been happening here? Do you have any idea what this means for both of us if this production fails?

However, it appears that some unforeseen circumstances have caused a slight disruption in the rehearsals. Rest assured, I am taking immediate action to rectify the situation and ensure that we meet our deadline. Thank you for bringing this to my attention. I apologize for any inconvenience caused.

A "slight disruption"? SLIGHT? Salieri, I don't think you understand the gravity of this! I left you detailed instructions — detailed! — and I come back to find absolute chaos! 

*picks up the papers and waves them*

The second act is practically unrehearsed! The principal soprano told me this morning she's been waiting for THREE DAYS for someone to clarify the blocking in her aria, and no one could tell her anything! And these stage directions — 

*thrusts a page toward him*

— these are NOT what I wrote! Someone has changed the entire finale staging, and I can only assume it was you, since you were left in charge!

"Unforeseen circumstances"? What circumstances could possibly justify this disaster? I trusted you, Antonio! The Emperor himself is expecting perfection, and instead we have... this shambles!

*voice rising with stress*

Ten days! We have ten days to salvage this, and you stand there speaking in pleasantries as if we have all the time in the world! What exactly are these "immediate actions" you're taking? Because from where I stand, it looks like nothing has been done at all!

I appreciate your concerns, and I am committed to doing everything within my power to restore order and excellence to these rehearsals.
